name: @humid/creds
description: HumID 4.0 (provisional): ask for and check public identity credentials through one interface. Digital Credentials API requests (OpenID4VP 1.0 + ISO 18013-7 Annex C), verification of mobile driver's licenses and IDs, EU digital identity (mdoc and SD-JWT VC) and wallet photo IDs with issuer trust, holder binding and revocation; passport and ID chips (server); license barcodes (unsigned); SSN structure and eCBSV for permitted entities; minimised claims committed to a persona.
